issue: मुनिवर संघ … लखि ब्रजभूमि यहाँ ठहराये: संघ read as संग ('with you'); who saw Braja and who stayed is not said: read as Girirāja staying.
our reading: When the great sage came into Braja with you, you saw the land of Braja and stayed here.
alternatives: The band of great sages came to Braja; or the sage, seeing Braja, set you down here.
